name: Technological University Dublin
summary: Dublin's technological university: about 100 honours degrees through CAO, from Architecture and Engineering to Culinary Arts, Music and Drama.

ib.text: Six subjects with Maths and English (or Irish); no third language. Some ask more: Engineering (General Entry) HL Maths 5; Mathematics and Statistics Maths SL 6 or HL 4; Law and Journalism HL English 5.

notes: Architecture (TU832) selects with a portfolio and an interview, several art and design courses ask for a portfolio, and Music and Drama audition.
From 2027 Drama (Performance) TU962 no longer requires Irish; it asks O2/H6 in English instead, which is IB SL 6 or HL 4.
